_note: 体检报告书的科室条目、具名异常所见、辅助检查叙述、总检结论与建议；门诊病历、心电图报告、居家记录的固定文字。全部手写，是教科书式的通用医学表述，不含任何来自真实语料的内容。异常所见的发生率只求量级对，不是流行病学估计。

zh: 心音有力，未闻及病理性杂音
双肺呼吸音清，未闻及干湿性啰音
生理反射存在，病理反射未引出
视盘边界清，动静脉比例正常
窦性心律 正常心电图
窦性心律，大致正常心电图
两肺纹理清晰，未见明显实质性病变。心影大小形态未见异常。双侧膈面光整，肋膈角锐利。
两肺野清晰，肺纹理走行自然。心影不大。膈面光滑，肋膈角锐利。
en: Lungs are clear. Cardiomediastinal silhouette within normal limits. Costophrenic angles sharp.

zh: 胸部平片未见明显异常
两肺野透亮度正常，肺纹理走行自然，未见明显实质性病变。气管及支气管通畅。纵隔未见肿大淋巴结。心影大小正常。胸腔未见积液。
en: Lungs are clear without nodule or consolidation. Airways patent. No mediastinal lymphadenopathy. No pleural effusion.

zh: 胸部CT平扫未见明显异常

abd_us.zh: 腹部超声（肝、胆、胰、脾、双肾）
abd_us.en: Abdominal ultrasound (liver, gallbladder, pancreas, spleen, kidneys)

zh: 肝脏形态大小正常，包膜光滑，实质回声均匀，肝内管道显示清晰，门静脉内径正常。
en: Liver normal in size and contour, homogeneous echotexture, intrahepatic ducts not dilated.

zh: 胆囊大小形态正常，壁不厚，腔内未见明显异常回声。
en: Gallbladder normal in size, wall not thickened, no stones.

zh: 胰腺形态大小正常，回声均匀，胰管无扩张。
脾脏形态大小正常，回声均匀。
en: Spleen normal in size and echotexture.

zh: 双肾形态大小正常，皮髓质分界清，集合系统无分离，未见明显异常回声。
en: Both kidneys normal in size, corticomedullary differentiation preserved, no hydronephrosis.

zh: 肝、胆、胰、脾、双肾未见明显异常
肝胆胰脾双肾声像图未见明显异常
en: No significant abnormality of the liver, gallbladder, pancreas, spleen or kidneys.

zh: 甲状腺双叶大小形态正常，包膜完整，实质回声均匀，未见明显占位性病变。CDFI：血流信号未见异常。
en: Both lobes normal in size, homogeneous echotexture, no focal lesion. Normal vascularity.

zh: 双侧颈总动脉、颈内动脉内径正常，内中膜光滑，未见明显斑块，血流通畅。
en: Common and internal carotid arteries of normal calibre, intima-media smooth, no plaque.

zh: 双侧颈动脉未见明显异常
双侧乳腺腺体层次清晰，回声均匀，未见明显占位性病变。双侧腋窝未见肿大淋巴结。
en: Fibroglandular tissue normal, no focal lesion. No axillary lymphadenopathy.

zh: 双侧乳腺未见明显异常
前列腺大小形态正常，包膜完整，内部回声均匀。
en: Prostate normal in size and echotexture.

zh: 子宫前位，大小形态正常，肌层回声均匀，内膜居中。双侧附件区未见明显异常回声。
en: Anteverted uterus of normal size, homogeneous myometrium. Adnexa unremarkable.

zh: 子宫及双附件未见明显异常
动脉弹性正常，未见明显动脉硬化
各房室内径正常，室壁厚度及运动正常，各瓣膜形态、启闭正常，未见明显异常血流信号。心包腔未见积液。
en: Normal chamber dimensions and wall thickness; normal valve morphology and function; no significant regurgitation; no pericardial effusion.

zh: 心脏结构及功能未见明显异常
双眼视盘边界清，色泽正常，C/D约0.3，视网膜血管走行正常，动静脉比例约2:3，黄斑中心凹反光存在，未见出血及渗出。
en: Both discs sharp with C/D ratio about 0.3; retinal vessels of normal calibre (A:V about 2:3); foveal reflex present; no haemorrhage or exudate.

zh: 双眼眼底未见明显异常
双侧乳腺呈散在纤维腺体型（b类），腺体分布对称，未见明确肿块、钙化及结构扭曲，皮肤及乳头未见异常，双侧腋窝未见肿大淋巴结。
en: Scattered fibroglandular density (type b), symmetric; no mass, suspicious calcification or architectural distortion; skin and nipples normal; no axillary lymphadenopathy.

mild.zh: 肝脏形态大小正常，实质回声细密增强，远场回声轻度衰减，肝内管道显示尚清晰。
mild.en: Liver normal in size; diffusely increased parenchymal echogenicity with mild posterior attenuation.

moderate.zh: 肝脏体积增大，实质回声弥漫性增强，远场回声明显衰减，肝内管道显示欠清晰。
moderate.en: Liver enlarged; diffusely increased echogenicity with marked posterior attenuation, vessels poorly seen.

finding.zh: 肝{lobe}叶见一无回声区，大小约{mm}mm，壁薄，边界清，后方回声增强。
finding.en: A {mm} mm thin-walled anechoic lesion in the {lobe_en} lobe with posterior enhancement.

finding.zh: 胆囊壁上见一强回声，大小约{mm}mm，不随体位改变移动，后方无声影。
finding.en: A {mm} mm non-mobile echogenic focus on the gallbladder wall without acoustic shadow.

finding.zh: 胆囊腔内见一强回声团，大小约{mm}mm，后方伴声影，随体位改变移动。
finding.en: A {mm} mm mobile echogenic focus with posterior acoustic shadowing within the gallbladder.

finding.zh: {side}肾集合系统内见一强回声，大小约{mm}mm，后方伴声影。
finding.en: A {mm} mm echogenic focus with acoustic shadowing in the {side_en} renal collecting system.

finding.zh: {side}肾见一无回声区，大小约{mm}mm，壁薄，边界清，后方回声增强。
finding.en: A {mm} mm simple cyst in the {side_en} kidney.

finding.zh: 甲状腺{side}叶见一{echo}回声结节，大小约{mm}mm，边界清，形态规则，内部回声均匀，CDFI：周边见少许血流信号。
finding.en: A {mm} mm well-defined {echo_en} nodule in the {side_en} lobe with regular margins and peripheral vascularity.

finding.zh: 甲状腺双叶大小正常或略增大，实质回声弥漫性减低、不均匀，呈网格状改变，CDFI：血流信号增多。
finding.en: Both lobes show diffusely heterogeneous, hypoechoic parenchyma with increased vascularity.

impression.zh: 甲状腺弥漫性病变（请结合甲状腺功能）
impression.en: Diffuse thyroid disease; correlate with thyroid function.

finding.zh: 双侧颈总动脉内中膜增厚，厚约1.1–1.3mm，回声增强，未见明显斑块。
finding.en: Bilateral common carotid intima-media thickening (1.1–1.3 mm) without discrete plaque.

impression.zh: 双侧颈动脉内中膜增厚

finding.zh: {side}侧颈总动脉分叉处见一强回声斑块，大小约{mm}×2.1mm，管腔未见明显狭窄。
finding.en: A {mm} × 2.1 mm echogenic plaque at the {side_en} carotid bifurcation without significant stenosis.

finding.zh: 双侧乳腺腺体层次欠清，回声增粗、分布不均，未见明显占位性病变。
finding.en: Fibroglandular tissue coarsened and heterogeneous bilaterally; no focal mass.

finding.zh: {side}侧乳腺{clock}点方向见一低回声结节，大小约{mm}mm，边界清，形态规则。
finding.en: A {mm} mm well-circumscribed hypoechoic nodule in the {side_en} breast at {clock} o'clock.

finding.zh: 前列腺体积增大，约4.6×3.8×3.2cm，内腺增大，回声不均，可见钙化斑。
finding.en: Prostate enlarged (4.6 × 3.8 × 3.2 cm) with heterogeneous transition zone and calcifications.

finding.zh: 子宫{wall}壁肌层内见一低回声结节，大小约{mm}mm，边界清，周边可见环状血流。
finding.en: A {mm} mm well-defined hypoechoic myometrial nodule in the {wall_en} wall with peripheral flow.

finding.zh: {side}肺{lobe_lung}叶见一{density}结节，直径约{mm}mm，边界清。余两肺未见明显实质性病变。纵隔未见肿大淋巴结。
finding.en: A {mm} mm {density_en} nodule in the {side_en} {lobe_lung_en} lobe. Lungs otherwise clear. No lymphadenopathy.

impression.zh: {side}肺{lobe_lung}叶微小结节，建议年度复查
impression.en: {side_en} {lobe_lung_en} lobe pulmonary nodule; annual follow-up suggested

finding.zh: 两肺纹理增粗、增多，未见明显实质性病变。心影大小形态未见异常。双侧膈面光整，肋膈角锐利。
finding.en: Bronchovascular markings mildly prominent; no consolidation. Heart size normal.

impression.zh: 窦性心律，部分导联T波改变（Ⅱ、Ⅲ、aVF）
impression.en: Sinus rhythm with nonspecific T-wave changes (II, III, aVF)

impression.zh: 窦性心律，偶发房性早搏
impression.en: Sinus rhythm with occasional premature atrial complexes

text.zh: 咽部黏膜慢性充血，咽后壁淋巴滤泡增生
text.en: Chronic pharyngeal congestion with lymphoid follicles

text.zh: 颈椎生理曲度变直，颈部活动轻度受限
text.en: Straightened cervical lordosis, mildly restricted neck movement

impression.zh: 轻度阻塞性通气功能障碍

summary.zh: 肺功能：阻塞性通气功能障碍

impression.zh: 轻度限制性通气功能障碍

summary.zh: 肺功能：限制性通气功能障碍

impression.zh: 臂踝脉搏波传导速度增快，提示动脉弹性减退
impression.en: Increased baPWV, consistent with reduced arterial compliance

impression.zh: 左侧踝臂指数减低，提示下肢动脉供血不足可能
impression.en: Reduced left ABI, suggesting lower-limb arterial disease

impression.zh: 室间隔增厚，左室肥厚可能
impression.en: Septal thickening; possible left ventricular hypertrophy

finding.zh: 双眼视网膜动脉变细，反光增强，动静脉比例约1:2，可见动静脉交叉压迫征，未见出血及渗出。
finding.en: Retinal arteriolar narrowing with increased light reflex, A:V about 1:2, arteriovenous nicking; no haemorrhage or exudate.

impression.zh: 双眼视网膜动脉硬化（Ⅰ–Ⅱ级）

finding.zh: 双侧乳腺呈散在纤维腺体型（b类），{side}乳外上象限见数枚散在粗大钙化，形态规则，未见成簇细小钙化，未见肿块及结构扭曲。
finding.en: Scattered fibroglandular density; a few coarse, regular calcifications in the upper outer {side_en} breast; no clustered microcalcification, mass or distortion.

fatty_liver.zh: 脂肪肝：建议控制饮食、加强运动、控制体重，限制饮酒，定期复查肝功能及肝脏超声。
fatty_liver.en: Fatty liver: dietary control, regular exercise and weight management; limit alcohol; repeat liver function tests and ultrasound periodically.

benign_cyst.zh: 囊肿：多为良性，一般无需特殊处理，建议每年复查超声观察变化。
benign_cyst.en: Cyst: usually benign; annual ultrasound follow-up is sufficient.

gb_polyp.zh: 胆囊息肉样病变：建议每 6–12 个月复查超声，若增大或直径超过 10mm 请至肝胆外科就诊。
gb_polyp.en: Gallbladder polyp: ultrasound every 6–12 months; consult hepatobiliary surgery if it grows or exceeds 10 mm.

gb_stone.zh: 胆囊结石：建议低脂饮食，规律进食早餐，定期复查；如出现右上腹痛请及时就诊。
gb_stone.en: Gallstones: low-fat diet, regular meals, periodic review; seek care for right upper quadrant pain.

kidney_stone.zh: 肾结石：建议多饮水，适当运动，定期复查泌尿系超声；如出现腰痛、血尿请及时就诊。
kidney_stone.en: Kidney stone: increase fluid intake, stay active, periodic ultrasound; seek care for flank pain or haematuria.

thyroid_nodule.zh: 甲状腺结节：建议每 6–12 个月复查甲状腺超声及甲状腺功能，必要时内分泌科就诊。
thyroid_nodule.en: Thyroid nodule: repeat thyroid ultrasound and function tests every 6–12 months; endocrinology review if indicated.

thyroid_diffuse.zh: 甲状腺弥漫性病变：建议内分泌科就诊，复查甲状腺功能及相关抗体。
thyroid_diffuse.en: Diffuse thyroid change: endocrinology review with thyroid function and antibody tests.

vascular.zh: 血管相关异常：建议控制血压、血脂、血糖，戒烟，低盐低脂饮食，定期复查颈动脉超声。
vascular.en: Vascular finding: control blood pressure, lipids and glucose; stop smoking; low-salt, low-fat diet; periodic carotid ultrasound.

breast.zh: 乳腺增生：建议保持心情舒畅，规律作息，每年复查乳腺超声。
breast.en: Fibrocystic change: annual breast ultrasound; no specific treatment needed.

breast_nodule.zh: 乳腺结节：建议 6 个月后复查乳腺超声，必要时乳腺外科就诊。
breast_nodule.en: Breast nodule: repeat ultrasound in 6 months; breast clinic review if indicated.

prostate.zh: 前列腺增生：建议避免久坐、憋尿，泌尿外科随诊，定期复查前列腺特异性抗原。
prostate.en: Prostatic hyperplasia: urology follow-up; periodic PSA.

fibroid.zh: 子宫肌瘤：建议每年复查妇科超声，如月经量增多请妇科就诊。
fibroid.en: Uterine fibroid: annual pelvic ultrasound; gynaecology review if menorrhagia develops.

lung_nodule.zh: 肺微小结节：建议 12 个月后复查胸部 CT，戒烟。
lung_nodule.en: Small pulmonary nodule: repeat chest CT in 12 months; stop smoking.

lung_markings.zh: 两肺纹理增粗：多见于吸烟或慢性支气管炎，建议戒烟，必要时呼吸科就诊。
lung_markings.en: Prominent lung markings: often related to smoking or chronic bronchitis; stop smoking.

brady.zh: 窦性心动过缓：如无不适一般无需处理，运动人群常见；如有头晕、乏力请心内科就诊。
brady.en: Sinus bradycardia: common in active individuals; cardiology review if dizziness or fatigue.

ecg_minor.zh: 心电图轻度异常：建议结合临床，必要时心内科就诊复查心电图。
ecg_minor.en: Minor ECG abnormality: correlate clinically; repeat ECG or cardiology review if indicated.

dental.zh: 口腔：建议口腔科就诊处理龋齿/牙结石，早晚刷牙，定期洁牙。
dental.en: Dental: see a dentist for caries or calculus; brush twice daily and have regular cleaning.

eye.zh: 眼科：建议注意用眼卫生，必要时眼科验光配镜。
eye.en: Eyes: eye hygiene; refraction and spectacles if needed.

ent.zh: 耳鼻喉科：建议避免刺激性饮食，戒烟，必要时耳鼻喉科就诊。
ent.en: ENT: avoid irritants, stop smoking; ENT review if symptomatic.

surgical_minor.zh: 外科：建议注意姿势，适当锻炼，避免久坐久站，必要时相关科室就诊。
surgical_minor.en: Surgical: posture and exercise; avoid prolonged sitting or standing; specialist review if needed.

gyn.zh: 妇科：建议定期妇科检查及宫颈细胞学筛查。
gyn.en: Gynaecology: regular gynaecological examination and cervical screening.

hp.zh: 幽门螺杆菌阳性：建议消化内科就诊，评估是否需要根除治疗，注意分餐。
hp.en: H. pylori positive: gastroenterology review for eradication therapy.

bone.zh: 骨量减少/骨质疏松：建议补充钙剂及维生素 D，适当负重运动，定期复查骨密度。
bone.en: Low bone density: calcium and vitamin D, weight-bearing exercise, periodic DXA.

lung_function.zh: 肺通气功能异常：建议戒烟，避免粉尘及刺激性气体，呼吸科就诊复查肺功能（支气管舒张试验）。
lung_function.en: Abnormal spirometry: stop smoking, avoid dust and irritants; respiratory review with post-bronchodilator spirometry.

echo_minor.zh: 心脏超声轻度异常：多为生理性或年龄相关改变，建议结合临床，控制血压，必要时心内科随诊。
echo_minor.en: Minor echocardiographic finding: often physiological or age-related; correlate clinically and control blood pressure.

body_fat.zh: 体脂率/内脏脂肪偏高：建议控制总热量，增加有氧运动与抗阻训练，减少腰围，定期复查。
body_fat.en: Raised body fat / visceral fat: reduce energy intake, add aerobic and resistance exercise, reduce waist circumference.

tcm.zh: 中医体质偏颇：建议根据体质类型调整饮食起居，规律作息，必要时中医科就诊调理。
tcm.en: TCM constitutional imbalance: adjust diet and daily routine according to constitution type; TCM consultation if desired.

lab_hepatitis.zh: 肝炎病毒标志物阳性（{items}）：建议感染科或肝病科就诊，复查肝功能、HBV-DNA 及肝脏超声，家人建议筛查并接种疫苗。
lab_hepatitis.en: Positive hepatitis serology ({items}): hepatology review with liver function tests, HBV DNA and ultrasound; screen and vaccinate household contacts.

lab_coag.zh: 凝血功能异常（{items}）：建议排除采血因素后复查凝血功能，必要时血液科就诊。
lab_coag.en: Abnormal coagulation ({items}): repeat after excluding sampling artefact; haematology review if persistent.

lab_cardiac.zh: 心肌标志物异常（{items}）：建议心内科就诊，复查心电图、心肌标志物及心脏超声。
lab_cardiac.en: Abnormal cardiac markers ({items}): cardiology review with ECG, repeat markers and echocardiography.

lab_renal_early.zh: 尿微量白蛋白异常（{items}）：提示早期肾损伤可能，建议控制血压、血糖，3 个月内复查尿白蛋白/肌酐比值，必要时肾内科就诊。
lab_renal_early.en: Raised urine albumin ({items}): possible early kidney damage; control blood pressure and glucose; repeat UACR within 3 months.

lab_immune.zh: 免疫/风湿指标异常（{items}）：建议风湿免疫科就诊，结合关节症状进一步检查。
lab_immune.en: Abnormal immunology ({items}): rheumatology review, correlate with joint symptoms.

lab_pancreas.zh: 胰酶异常（{items}）：建议复查，如有上腹痛请消化内科就诊。
lab_pancreas.en: Abnormal pancreatic enzymes ({items}): repeat; gastroenterology review if abdominal pain.

lab_stool.zh: 便潜血阳性：建议消化内科就诊，必要时行胃肠镜检查。
lab_stool.en: Positive faecal occult blood: gastroenterology review; endoscopy if indicated.

lab_hp.zh: 幽门螺杆菌抗体阳性：抗体阳性不能区分现症感染与既往感染，建议行碳13/碳14呼气试验确认后决定是否根除。
lab_hp.en: H. pylori antibody positive: serology cannot distinguish current from past infection; confirm with a urea breath test.

lab_cervical.zh: 宫颈癌筛查异常（{items}）：建议妇科就诊，必要时行阴道镜检查；高危型 HPV 阳性者 12 个月后复查。
lab_cervical.en: Abnormal cervical screening ({items}): gynaecology review; colposcopy if indicated; repeat HPV in 12 months.

lab_lipid.zh: 血脂异常（{items}）：建议低脂饮食，控制体重，加强运动，3–6 个月复查血脂；必要时心内科或内分泌科就诊。
lab_lipid.en: Dyslipidaemia ({items}): low-fat diet, weight control, exercise; repeat lipids in 3–6 months.

lab_glucose.zh: 血糖异常（{items}）：建议控制饮食、加强运动，复查空腹血糖及糖化血红蛋白，必要时内分泌科就诊。
lab_glucose.en: Abnormal glucose ({items}): diet and exercise; repeat fasting glucose and HbA1c; endocrinology review if indicated.

lab_liver.zh: 肝功能异常（{items}）：建议戒酒，避免肝损药物，休息，2–4 周后复查肝功能。
lab_liver.en: Abnormal liver function ({items}): avoid alcohol and hepatotoxic drugs; repeat in 2–4 weeks.

lab_renal.zh: 肾功能异常（{items}）：建议多饮水，避免肾毒性药物，肾内科就诊复查。
lab_renal.en: Abnormal renal function ({items}): hydration, avoid nephrotoxic drugs; nephrology review.

lab_ua.zh: 尿酸偏高：建议低嘌呤饮食，限制饮酒，多饮水，定期复查。
lab_ua.en: Raised uric acid: low-purine diet, limit alcohol, hydration, periodic review.

lab_cbc.zh: 血常规异常（{items}）：建议复查血常规，必要时血液科就诊。
lab_cbc.en: Abnormal blood count ({items}): repeat CBC; haematology review if persistent.

lab_anemia.zh: 贫血（{items}）：建议查找病因，补充含铁食物，血液科或消化科就诊。
lab_anemia.en: Anaemia ({items}): investigate cause; iron-rich diet; haematology review.

lab_thyroid.zh: 甲状腺功能异常（{items}）：建议内分泌科就诊，复查甲状腺功能。

lab_tumor.zh: 肿瘤标志物偏高（{items}）：单项轻度升高多无临床意义，建议 1–3 个月复查，必要时专科就诊。
lab_tumor.en: Raised tumour marker ({items}): mild isolated elevation is often non-specific; repeat in 1–3 months.

lab_urine.zh: 尿常规异常（{items}）：建议清洁中段尿复查，必要时肾内科或泌尿科就诊。
lab_urine.en: Abnormal urinalysis ({items}): repeat with a clean-catch sample.

lab_bp.zh: 血压偏高：建议低盐饮食，规律作息，家庭自测血压并记录，如持续升高请心内科就诊。
lab_bp.en: Raised blood pressure: low-salt diet, home blood pressure monitoring; cardiology review if persistent.

lab_bmi.zh: 超重/肥胖：建议控制饮食总量，增加运动，减轻体重。
lab_bmi.en: Overweight/obesity: reduce energy intake, increase activity.

lab_other.zh: 其他检验异常（{items}）：建议结合临床，定期复查。
lab_other.en: Other abnormal results ({items}): correlate clinically and repeat.

normal.zh: 本次体检未见明显异常，建议保持健康的生活方式，定期体检。
normal.en: No significant abnormality found. Maintain a healthy lifestyle and have regular check-ups.

zh: 以上建议仅供参考，如有不适请及时就医。
本报告不作为疾病诊断证明，具体诊疗请遵专科医师意见。
